mapper.sql: w.id, w.book_id, w.priority_rank, w.word, w.phonetic, w.part_of_speech, w.chinese_meaning, w.korean_meaning, w.korean_equivalents, w.korean_definition, w.english_example, w.korean_example, w.learning_stage, w.selection_basis, COALESCE(p.status, 'NEW') AS progress_status

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM words w WHERE w.book_id = #{bookId}
AND ( LOWER(w.word) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{keyword}), '%') OR w.chinese_meaning LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR w.korean_meaning LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )

SELECT id, word, chinese_meaning, korean_meaning FROM words WHERE book_id = #{bookId} AND id != #{wordId} ORDER BY CASE WHEN LEFT(LOWER(word), 3) = LEFT(LOWER(#{word}), 3) THEN 0 WHEN LEFT(LOWER(word), 2) = LEFT(LOWER(#{word}), 2) THEN 1 WHEN LENGTH(word) = LENGTH(#{word}) THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, RAND() LIMIT #{limit}
